name: redraw one variable from its conditional given the rest
mechanism: cycle through the variables; replace each in turn by a fresh draw from its distribution conditioned on the current values of all the others; every such move is accepted, and the joint sequence converges to the target

sources.ref: List of algorithms (revid 1373672109), entry 'Gibbs sampling' in section Computational mathematics / Numerical algorithms / Monte Carlo: generates a sequence of samples from the joint probability distribution of two or more random variables

requires: a samplable conditional for every variable
fails_when: strongly coupled variables move very slowly
